adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts, line 97 shows `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);`. The parseRefreshTokenResponse function (in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts) returns the result of `schema.safeParse(response)` which is `{success: true, data: ...}` or `{success: false, error: ...}`. The code then does `data: { key }` to update the credential. This means the stored key will be the safeParse envelope object `{success: true, data: {...}}` instead of the actual credential data. The original code was `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials);` which returned the parsed data directly. This is a real bug that would break credential storage.
